svg.title: 粉色圣诞热可可杯｜平滑曲线矢量插画
svg.desc: Manually reconstructed smooth vector paths based on the supplied pink cocoa mug illustration. Pink bow, winter holly, candy-striped handle and wafer, whipped cream and marshmallows, cinnamon, iced star cookie and steam. Watercolor grain simplified to editable vector shading. No embedded raster images, fonts, filters or opacity.
